name: [☃️ UPD] Pablo's Italiano Restaurant
desc:
Welcome to Pablo's Italiano Restaurant and Island!

Here we redefine the world of Italian roleplay! Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure with your friends by having unique dining experiences and savoring delectable meals at our renowned Pablo's Italiano Restaurant. Indulge in the exquisite flavors of our authentic Italian cuisine, meticulously prepared by our skilled chefs using the finest ingredients. From mouthwatering pasta dishes to tantalizing salmon straight from the island's freshwater ocean, each bite at Pablo's is a celebration of taste and tradition.

📌 IMPORTANT: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/pablos-important-information
📌 HIRING INFO: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/pablos-application-guide-hiring-instructions

Kindly be aware that this game is currently in active development, and as such, you may encounter occasional bugs and glitches. We appreciate your patience and support as we strive to deliver an enjoyable experience.
